extracted.intended_audience: T‑Mobile customers (Primary Account Holders) who are eligible for or managing the Hulu streaming benefit
extracted.subtask_description: Step‑by‑step instructions and requirements for T‑Mobile customers to add, redeem, manage, or cancel the Hulu benefit tied to their mobile account, including special notes for former Sprint customers and customers with existing Hulu subscriptions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility for Hulu with T‑Mobile
rubrics_metrics.description: Get support or redeem Hulu with T‑Mobile for eligible plans.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only one Hulu plan is available per account but all supported devices can download the Hulu application. When logged in to your account in T‑Life or My T‑Mobile (on a web browser), you can see what Hulu options are available to you.

rubrics_metrics.name: Existing Hulu subscription must be cancelled before redeeming Hulu ON US
rubrics_metrics.description: If you have an existing Hulu subscription billed through a third‑party or directly from Hulu, you'll need to cancel your Hulu account and wait until the end of your billing period to redeem the Hulu ON US offer from T‑Mobile.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: As soon as your Hulu subscription becomes inactive (you'll have the exact date on your Hulu Account page), you are ready to redeem or add Hulu with T‑Mobile.

rubrics_metrics.name: Primary Account Holder must perform redemption
rubrics_metrics.description: Open T‑Life and log in to your account as the Primary Account Holder.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The redemption/add flow requires the Primary Account Holder to sign in to T‑Life (or My T‑Mobile on a web browser) to manage plans and add services.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to add or redeem Hulu via T‑Life / My T‑Mobile
rubrics_metrics.description: Detailed procedural steps to select and activate a Hulu subscription option from the T‑Mobile account interface.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Go to the Manage tab > See plans > Manage Data & add‑ons. Scroll down to Services. Select a Hulu subscription option (eligibility may vary based on your plan), then click Continue (at the bottom of the page). Review the Order Page and click Agree & submit. You are routed to the Start Activation Page. Click Third‑Party service terms and click Start Activation. You receive an SMS message with a link. Click the link in the SMS. Follow the link and complete registration on Hulu's site: Enter email address and select Continue. Enter password and select log in. Fill out additional information and select Save & Continue. Start streaming.

rubrics_metrics.name: Alternative when 'Cannot add via app' error occurs
rubrics_metrics.description: If you receive the ‘Cannot add via app’ message, use T‑Mobile.com to make the change.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For more details, go to the Manage your plan page where you can find information about managing settings and preferences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Activation requires accepting third‑party terms and SMS link flow
rubrics_metrics.description: Activation involves accepting Third‑Party service terms and completing registration via an SMS link to Hulu.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: On the Start Activation Page click Third‑Party service terms and click Start Activation. You receive an SMS message with a link. Click the link in the SMS and complete registration on Hulu's site (email, password, additional info).

rubrics_metrics.name: Manage add‑on subscriptions via Hulu account page (for existing Hulu subscribers)
rubrics_metrics.description: Existing Hulu subscribers can make changes to their plan by going to Hulu on a computer or mobile device and using their Account page.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Log in and go to your Account page to manage your add‑ons. If you need additional support, visit the Hulu Help Center.

rubrics_metrics.name: Manage Hulu for former Sprint customers
rubrics_metrics.description: Special note for former Sprint customers with a Hulu plan included with wireless service: they can manage or cancel Hulu via their Hulu account page.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you are an eligible former Sprint customer with a Hulu plan included with your wireless service you can cancel your Hulu plan by going to your Hulu account page.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to cancel Hulu subscription (former Sprint customers)
rubrics_metrics.description: Steps to cancel a Hulu plan included with wireless service for eligible former Sprint customers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Login to your Hulu account. Click Cancel and follow the steps.

rubrics_metrics.name: Personalize Hulu experience using profiles
rubrics_metrics.description: For an overview of how Hulu profiles work, consult the Manage your Profiles guidance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use profiles to personalize the streaming experience; see Hulu's Manage your Profiles help documentation for details.
